title: Here's how to reach out to a recruiter or hiring manager who's listed on a job posting on Linkedin.
transcript: Here's how to reach out to a recruiter or a hiring manager who you see listed on a LinkedIn job post. There is an art to sliding into the DMs politely and we are going to show you how. Head to your Teal job tracker and go to the roles that are in the applying stage. In the far right, you'll see a little envelope symbol. That is where all of our free communication templates are stored that you can use for email and LinkedIn. Go to the cold outreach section and then the first template that pops up is this template for reaching out to a recruiter on LinkedIn. You can then copy this message directly into LinkedIn. Just make sure to customize it before you hit send. Save this for later or pause and take a screenshot if you want this exact text. Hope this helps.
